author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Most people don’t know this, but Gmail lets you create unlimited email addresses from a single account — no extra inboxes and no new sign-ups required.

In this video, I show you two built-in Gmail tricks: plus addressing and dot addresses. You’ll learn how to use them to automatically filter emails, keep your inbox organized, and even track which websites share or leak your email address.

This is perfect for newsletters, online shopping, receipts, subscriptions, and reducing inbox clutter — all while managing everything from one Gmail account.

Host: Kevin Stratvert
